summary: kvwatch replaces emptying a cache on a re-read with a read protocol (BeginRead / Apply with per-read marks / CompleteRead sweep) shared by the session, interest and CI caches, an epoch guard for writes outside the watcher, and a serving state: never before the first complete read, and not once the copy stopped following (new read, watcher end, recreate flagged by Check, NATS disconnect hook) for longer than min(2 min, MaxAge/2). The listener's GET /v1/sessions and GET /v1/interests/ (and the closed start gate for those two reads) answer 503 + Retry-After: 5 + code refilling; envoy_active_sessions/interests publish no sample then. Dispatch maps it to 503 ENVOY_REFILLING and route_status unknown + route_status_reason refilling; every web view stops deriving absence, zero counts or 'no agents' from a read that is not current and shows the refilling text.

findings.finding: Stale allowance could renew on each retry; failed replacement setup unspecified
findings.answer: D5: staleSince is set only if zero, so one episode spans every failed or replaced read until a complete read; a Rewatch failing before install changes nothing (a healthy watcher stays following, an ended one already started the episode). Task 1 test crosses the bound over several failed generations.

findings.finding: Completion, generation check, sweep and serving transition need one serialized protocol; Check can invalidate without a generation change
findings.answer: D2: complete takes applyMu, rechecks generation/stopped/Check error under mu, sweeps with mu released, then sets following only if still valid; hooks run with applyMu held and mu released; order cache mutex -> w.mu. Task 1 tests hold the nil across Rewatch, Check and Stop.

findings.finding: Clearing the fence on recreate is unsafe while old-bucket reads/writes are in flight, for all three adapters
findings.answer: D3: kvwatch Epoch bumps only on a different stream; every write-through, read-through, delete and CI CAS captures (handle, epoch) and applies only if the epoch is unchanged under the adapter mutex. Task 2 interleaving tests.

findings.finding: Seen-set marking relative to fence rejection and read-throughs was undefined
findings.answer: D4: mark every current-generation delivery before the fence comparison and every current-epoch write/read/delete; a D3-dropped result marks nothing; sweep removes unmarked entries. Task 2 tests assert values and membership for the five named cases.

findings.finding: Timed-out scan retry lifecycle incomplete; fixture forwards a second nil
findings.answer: D6: rereadTimer armed through AfterFunc, cleared by install and Stop; watch(expect=G) compare-and-install; setup failure re-arms; TimingOut fixture drops the later nil. Premature end goes through the reconnect hook and the self-health rebuild, named and tested.

findings.finding: Suspending expiry in Get/LastSeen changes single-session liveness, possibly forever
findings.answer: D7: only List retains expired rows while not following; Get keeps not-found for an expired row (so roleHolderSession falls through to Refresh); a row is never deleted during a read. Task 2 test.

findings.finding: Metric deps==nil rule contradicts /v1 opening before deps.Store
findings.answer: D9: the metric reads a pointer openV1Routes publishes when /v1 opens; before that the gate answers refilling and the metric has no sample. Task 3 durable-bind-window test.

findings.finding: One listing function must not add NATS reads to metrics; snapshot boundary and lock order
findings.answer: D8: listedSessions checks both Servable() (watcher state, no cache locks) then List(); the list join uses a cache-only Cached(id); the metric counts without the join. Task 3 tests: interest-only refusal, no NATS read with NATS stalled.

findings.finding: Reaper guard ambiguous and racy
findings.answer: D10: Reap collects candidates under the interest lock without calling the session registry, then confirms each with the per-id authoritative liveness (roleHolderMayBeLive: cache hit, else bucket Refresh; error keeps) before deleting. Held-pass test.

findings.finding: Bound tied to the TTL seen at Open; rebuild-count rationale unsupported
findings.answer: D5: bound = min(2 min, MaxAge/2) from the stream read before every install (StreamState.MaxAge); D15 session TTL follows a recreate; the rebuild-count claim was removed.

findings.finding: Not every consumer of the list was covered (credentials, claim chip, filter, broadcast, conversation controls, list/board route status)
findings.answer: D12 enumerates every useAgents consumer and what each shows; title-only consumers keep a label fallback, stated explicitly; list/board render nothing for unknown and the issue page gives the reason, as the spec says.

findings.finding: Retained earlier data can still authorize absence claims
findings.answer: D12 precedence: rows may stay but every absence claim requires current (the latest read succeeded). Task 7 e2e drives 200-nonempty->refilling->recovery, 200-empty->refilling and initial refilling.

findings.finding: route_status_reason needs the issue-cache PATCH merge and fixtures
findings.answer: D11/task 6: reason moves through model, contracts, read responses, issue-cache.ts reset on route change, fixtures and tests together.

findings.finding: Existing tests pin reset-time disappearance and timeout policy
findings.answer: Task 1/2/3 name the tests to replace (kvwatch_test.go :282-311, :348-356, :537-593; warmup_test.go :130-170; store/kv_test.go :1976-2023; listener gate expectations) and synchronize on a completed read.

findings.finding: Acceptance 2 had no proof surface
findings.answer: P2: rig scenario interrupt (SIGSTOP past the idle timer, or kill/restart NATS) recording which path ran and marking a missed window invalid; per-outcome deterministic locks in task 1.

findings.finding: Acceptance 1/3/4 clauses uncovered; count-only oracle weak
findings.answer: P1 asserts by identity with old/both/new sets, changed values, interest-bucket recreate and identical-record recreate; P3 covers boot, past-bound, recovery, empty zero; P5 covers both subscriber routes, ask card, route behaviour and the unreachable distinction; renewal across old expiry is a task 2 clock test.

findings.finding: /healthz serving fields are not observable on the NATS-down paths
findings.answer: D16: /healthz unchanged and not an oracle; /v1/sessions and /metrics are.

findings.finding: The claimed first-read ended-agents defect is unreachable (AgentsPage returns early)
findings.answer: Corrected: the reachable case is retained rows plus a non-current read, covered by D12's current rule.

findings.finding: 'A refill cannot be provoked in production without deleting the bucket' is wrong
findings.answer: Rephrased: pre-merge-only proof is a safety choice; same-bucket reads run on every reconnect and self-health rebuild.
